func (m *allTags) appendV20(buf []byte) ([]byte, error) {
	var err error

	buf = vi64.Append(buf, uint64(m.RequestID))
	buf = vi64.Append(buf, uint64(len(m.TrackName)))
	buf = append(buf, m.TrackName...)
	buf = vi64.Append(buf, uint64(len(m.ErrorReason)))
	buf = append(buf, m.ErrorReason...)
	buf = vi64.Append(buf, uint64(len(m.TrackNamespace)))
	for _, v := range m.TrackNamespace {
		buf = vi64.Append(buf, uint64(len(v)))
		buf = append(buf, v...)
	}
	if m.EndOfTrack {
		buf = append(buf, 1)
	} else {
		buf = append(buf, 0)
	}
	buf = m.EndLocation.append(buf)
	buf, err = m.Parameters.appendNum(buf)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	buf = m.Properties.appendDelta(buf)
	return buf, nil
}

	data = data[n:]
	if trackNamespaceCount > 32 {
		return errTooManyFields

	// The count cannot exceed the remaining bytes: every element costs at
	// least one byte, so this bounds the allocation without trusting it.
	if trackNamespaceCount > uint64(len(data)) {
